      "relationships": [

        "All pressures are absolute; the process of reaching the stop is considered the transition point."

        "Safety condition: pressure must not exceed 150 kPa"

    {

          "blockId": "B3"
        },
        {
          "name": "electrical work per cycle (Mode A)",
          "value": "180",
          "unit": "kJ",

          "blockId": "B3"

        {
          "name": "cycle time (Mode A)",
          "value": "60",
          "unit": "giây",

          "blockId": "B3"
        },
        {
          "name": "heat extracted per cycle (Mode B)",
          "value": "600",
          "unit": "kJ",
          "sourceText": "chế độ B, mỗi chu trình lấy 600 kJ từ ngăn lạnh",
          "blockId": "B3"

        {
          "name": "electrical work per cycle (Mode B)",
          "value": "240",
          "unit": "kJ",

        {
          "name": "cycle time (Mode B)",
          "value": "40",
          "unit": "giây",
          "sourceText": "mất 40 giây",
          "blockId": "B3"
        },
        {
          "name": "required total heat removal",
          "value": "2160",
          "unit": "kJ",
          "sourceText": "Tải cần lấy khỏi ngăn lạnh là 2160 kJ",
          "blockId": "B3"
        },
        {
          "name": "maximum total operation time",
          "value": "200",
          "unit": "giây",
          "sourceText": "Tổng thời gian tối đa là 200 giây",
          "blockId": "B3"
        },
        {
          "name": "maximum electrical energy budget",
          "value": "800",
          "unit": "kJ",
          "sourceText": "ngân sách điện tối đa là 800 kJ",
          "blockId": "B3"
        }
      ],
      "conditions": [
        "A mode or any combination of the two modes may be used; partial cycles are allowed.",
        "Energy flows within each mode are assumed constant during operation.",
        "Switching time between modes is ignored; no other heat flows are considered.",
        "All comparisons that change the budget must be explicitly identified as hypothetical."
      ],
      "relationships": [
        "Coefficient of performance (COP) = Q_c / W",
        "Heat extracted and electrical work scale linearly with operating time for each mode"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "excluded": []
}
